Container.Name: castaway
Container.Overview: Self-hosted RTMP streaming. OBS pushes RTMP in on 1935, viewers watch HLS on 8080 with viewer-side connection diagnostics. Optional Intel QSV adaptive bitrate transcoding (480p/720p/1080p) when /dev/dri is mounted, optional viewer password, optional stream-key auth.
Container.Description:
Self-hosted RTMP streaming with viewer-side connection diagnostics. OBS streams to rtmp://<host>:1935/live/<stream-key>. Open http://<host>:8080/ to see a lobby of currently-live channels, click one to watch fullscreen with stats overlay (resolution, bitrate, bandwidth estimate, buffer, latency, dropped frames, stalls).
Adaptive bitrate (ABR) transcoding via Intel Quick Sync: pass through /dev/dri to enable. Viewer-side quality selector picks the right variant automatically.
Optional viewer password (VIEWER_PASSWORD) and stream-key allowlist (STREAM_KEYS).

Config.Name: Viewer password
Config.Description: If set, viewers must enter this password (HTTP Basic Auth) to load the player. Leave empty for open access.

Config.Name: Stream keys
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed OBS stream keys (e.g. 'apex-legends,desktop'). Leave empty to allow any key.

Config.Name: ABR mode
Config.Description: auto = QSV if /dev/dri is mounted, else off. Options: auto, qsv, cpu, off.

Config.Name: Intel GPU (for QSV)
Config.Description: Mount your Intel iGPU/Arc GPU for hardware-accelerated ABR transcoding. Remove if you don't have one — ABR will auto-disable.
